info.title: COMPA API
info.description:
COMPA API. Sign-in is LinkedIn only (Supabase session cookie, set by `/auth/callback`).

**Mock mode** (no auth, no database): set `API_MODE=mock` on the deployment, or send `x-compa-mock: 1`, or add `?mock=1`.
Responses are the examples in this document. Pick an error with `x-compa-mock-error: <code>` or `x-compa-mock-status: <status>`
(also `?mockError=` / `?mockStatus=`), and a named success example with `x-compa-mock-example: <name>`.
